# Literal implementation of the criterion description.
# - First-person singular pronouns as whole words, case-insensitive.
# - A line starting with 'Note'/'Notes', optionally after '*', '_', '#', '>' markers.
# - Meta phrases: 'for your review', 'let me know', 'I omitted'.

_PRONOUN = re.compile(r"\b(?:i've|i'm|i'd|i'll|i|me|my)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
_NOTE_LINE = re.compile(r"^[ \t]*(?:[*_#>][ \t]*)*notes?\b", re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE)
_PHRASES = re.compile(r"for\s+your\s+review|let\s+me\s+know|i\s+omitted", re.IGNORECASE)


def evaluate(output: str, inputs: dict) -> bool:
    if output is None:
        return True
    if not isinstance(output, str):
        output = str(output)
    if _PRONOUN.search(output):
        return False
    if _NOTE_LINE.search(output):
        return False
    if _PHRASES.search(output):
        return False
    return True
"},{"name":"precision_focused_pronoun_and_annotation","code":"import re

# Looser, precision-oriented interpretation:
# - Only flags 'I' when it plausibly is the pronoun: uppercase, standalone, not a
#   roman numeral (e.g. 'Type I', 'Grade I', 'I, II and III'), not hyphen/slash
#   adjacent ('I-beam'), not 'I.e.'.
# - 'me'/'my' flagged in lower/title case only (ignores all-caps abbreviations like
#   'ME'), and ignores the idiom 'me-time' / 'me time'.
# - Text inside double quotes is treated as quoted speech, not author voice.
# - 'Note' lines must look like annotations: 'Note:' / 'Notes -' / 'Note (' etc.,
#   so product copy like 'Notes of vanilla' passes.
# - Meta phrases checked on the full text.

_QUOTED = re.compile(r'"[^"\n]{0,500}"|“[^”\n]{0,500}”')
_I_PRONOUN = re.compile(r"(?<![\w\-/])I(?![\w\-/])(?!\.[A-Za-z]\.)")
_ME_MY = re.compile(r"(?<![\w\-/])(?:me|Me|my|My)(?![\w\-/])(?!\s+time\b)")
_ROMAN_BEFORE = re.compile(
    r"(?:type|class|grade|level|stage|phase|part|gen|generation|series|mark|mk|model|"
    r"version|ver|chapter|vol|volume|size|category|cat|tier|step|war|book|act|section|"
    r"\bii|\biii|\biv|\bv|\bvi|\bx)[\s.,:#]*$",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_ROMAN_AFTER = re.compile(r"^\s*(?:,|/|&|\band\b|\bor\b|\bto\b|-)\s*(?:II|III|IV|V|VI|X)\b")
_NOTE_LINE = re.compile(
    r"^[ \t]*(?:[*_#>][ \t]*)*notes?[ \t]*(?:[*_]+[ \t]*)?[:\-–—(]",
    re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE,
)
_PHRASES = re.compile(r"for\s+your\s+review|let\s+me\s+know|i\s+omitted", re.IGNORECASE)


def _has_i_pronoun(text: str) -> bool:
    for m in _I_PRONOUN.finditer(text):
        before = text[max(0, m.start() - 30):m.start()]
        after = text[m.end():m.end() + 20]
        if _ROMAN_BEFORE.search(before):
            continue
        if _ROMAN_AFTER.search(after):
            continue
        return True
    return False


def evaluate(output: str, inputs: dict) -> bool:
    if output is None:
        return True
    if not isinstance(output, str):
        output = str(output)

    if _PHRASES.search(output):
        return False
    if _NOTE_LINE.search(output):
        return False

    unquoted = _QUOTED.sub(" ", output)
    if _has_i_pronoun(unquoted):
        return False
    if _ME_MY.search(unquoted):
        return False
    return True
"},{"name":"strict_meta_commentary_detector","code":"import re

# Stricter interpretation aimed at catching any trace of the writer's own voice or
# meta-commentary to the requester.
# - Normalizes curly apostrophes.
# - Case-insensitive first-person singular: I (and contractions), me, my, myself, mine.
#   Only exemption: the abbreviation 'i.e.'.
# - 'Note'/'Notes' at line start after any markdown/list markers (*, _, #, >, -, +,
#   bullets, numbers, brackets), plus inline '(Note: ...)' or sentence-initial 'Note:'.
# - Expanded list of meta phrases.

_APOS = str.maketrans({"’": "'", "‘": "'", "ʼ": "'", "＇": "'", "`": "'"})

_PRONOUN = re.compile(
    r"\b(?:i(?!\.e\b)|i've|i'm|i'd|i'll|me|my|myself|mine)\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_NOTE_LINE = re.compile(
    r"^[ \t*_#>+•|(\[\d.)\]-]*notes?\b",
    re.IGNORECASE | re.MULTILINE,
)
_NOTE_INLINE = re.compile(
    r"[(\[][ \t]*[*_]*[ \t]*notes?[ \t]*[*_]*[ \t]*:"
    r"|(?:[.!?])[ \t]+[*_]*notes?[*_]*[ \t]*:",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_PHRASES = re.compile(
    r"for\s+your\s+review|let\s+me\s+know|i\s+omitted|i've\s+omitted|i\s+have\s+omitted"
    r"|as\s+requested|per\s+your\s+request|word\s+count|hope\s+this\s+helps",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


def evaluate(output: str, inputs: dict) -> bool:
    if output is None:
        return True
    if not isinstance(output, str):
        output = str(output)
    text = output.translate(_APOS)

    if _PRONOUN.search(text):
        return False
    if _NOTE_LINE.search(text):
        return False
    if _NOTE_INLINE.search(text):
        return False
    if _PHRASES.search(text):
        return False
    return True
